data.description:
## Goal
After second-source verification passes, update the epic PREPLANNING_CONTEXT comment with self-application evidence proving typed-enum verifier, renderer, and handoff gate were applied to this epic's own story closures.

## Steps
1. Run second-source-verifier.md agent on all closed stories in loose-chasm-knot epic
2. Collect structured report from agent
3. Append SELF_APPLICATION_EVIDENCE block to PREPLANNING_CONTEXT comment on epic f9de-b7d9-c23e-4f5b with: {stories_audited, mechanisms_confirmed, second_source_verdict}

## Acceptance Criteria
- .claude/scripts/dso ticket show f9de-b7d9-c23e-4f5b | grep SELF_APPLICATION_EVIDENCE -> non-empty result
- second_source_verdict=PASS in the evidence block
- bash tests/scripts/test-second-source-verification.sh exits 0 (still GREEN)

## Testing Mode
GREEN (audit + comment update; depends S11/T2; blocked by S-ExtDep)
data.title: T3: GREEN — Update PREPLANNING_CONTEXT with self-application evidence
